name: vss_stores
description: List the volume shadow copies on an image with vshadowinfo: one store per snapshot, with its identifier, creation time and size, and the vshadowmount command that exposes it as a volume under your own work/<your id>/ directory, to list and extract from.

image.description: The image, or a single volume from it

offset.description: Volume offset in BYTES (vshadowinfo takes bytes, not sectors)

mount_dir.description: Where the vshadowmount command it suggests mounts the stores (default work/<your id>/vss: your own directory, the part of work/ a VM can write)
